name: <8 GB
recommendation_es: Poca VRAM: modelos GGUF o cuantizados, resolución baja y lotes de uno. El video será lento.
recommendation_en: Low VRAM: GGUF or quantized models, low resolution and batch size one. Video will be slow.

name: 8 GB
recommendation_es: Modelos GGUF o FP8, lotes de uno y resolución moderada. En video, clips cortos.
recommendation_en: GGUF or FP8 models, batch size one and moderate resolution. Keep video clips short.

name: 12 GB
recommendation_es: Imagen con modelos FP8 sin problemas; en video, GGUF o FP8 y resolución moderada.
recommendation_en: Image models in FP8 run comfortably; for video use GGUF or FP8 at moderate resolution.

name: 16 GB
recommendation_es: Imagen en FP8 o FP16 y video con GGUF o FP8; ajusta resolución y duración al workflow.
recommendation_en: Image in FP8 or FP16 and video with GGUF or FP8; adjust resolution and length to the workflow.

name: 24 GB
recommendation_es: Modelos de imagen en FP16 y la mayoría de workflows de video en FP8.
recommendation_en: FP16 image models and most video workflows in FP8.

name: 32 GB
recommendation_es: Video en alta resolución con FP8 y modelos grandes de imagen en FP16.
recommendation_en: High-resolution video in FP8 and large FP16 image models.

name: 48 GB
recommendation_es: Modelos grandes en FP16 con margen y lotes de más de una imagen.
recommendation_en: Large FP16 models with headroom and batches larger than one.

name: 64 GB+
recommendation_es: Modelos completos en FP16 y lotes grandes; la VRAM deja de ser el límite habitual.
recommendation_en: Full FP16 models and large batches; VRAM is rarely the limit.
